csv_project_name: AE Services for Track Athlete and Operations Facility
csv_scope_of_work: Montana State University-Bozeman (MSU) is seeking an experienced firm to provide complete design services for the design of a Track Athlete and Operations Facility on the MSU Bozeman campus. The successful firm will have experience in planning, programming, and designing student athlete support facilities and event operations and support facilities. The total cost of the project is to be determined based on donor engagement. The Track Athlete and Operations Facility is intended to serve student athletes with a variety of resources to support student athlete care and performance and to support athletic program needs. Space will also be provided to support the operational needs of events occurring in Bobcat Stadium, Kennedy Stark Indoor Athletic Center and Bobcat Track and Field Complex. Additionally, the project may address expanded seating capacity for the Bobcat track and Field Complex. The exact program will be developed through stakeholder engagement with athletes, coaches, administrative, and facility staff. An assessment of location options in close proximity to the facilities noted above will be needed to align the projects goals with operational efficiencies and expectations for donor engagement.
